body:
## Short summary of the bug

Fix Widget left-select / Form open behaviour so Form data is filled, by sending form-ready data objects.

## Description

When an object is selected on the visualisation, it is a JSON object. The Form expects an object categorised into four dicts, based on their common form behaviour:

- base_required
- base_optional
- object
- extensions

To fix this we require the current data object from the left-select function to be sent through a filter before it goes out as a message. The filter would rearrange any property name and value pair into one of the four categories (pseudocode in issue description).

## Steps to Reproduce

1. Go to widget
2. Left-select object
3. Form appears but does not fill

## Expected Behavior

Form should fill.

## Actual Behavior

Form does not fill.

## Source

- **Source issue**: https://github.com/os-threat/os-threat-alpha-1-program/issues/95
title: Fix Widget left-select / Form open behaviour so Form data is filled, by sending form-ready data objects
